name: NIST 5G O-RAN Testbed Automation Tool Version 1.7
known_limitations: The page documents an open-source automation release and experimentally verified component connections in NIST testbeds. It does not establish commercial interoperability, certification, security assurance, operator deployment, or a completed 6G standard.
source_owner: National Institute of Standards and Technology
automation_notes: Track software releases, reproducible deployments, published test results, specification conformance, certification use, and external operator or laboratory adoption.
notes: Phase 55N software milestone. NIST lists version 1.7, last updated May 6, 2026, with multi-UE, split CU-DU, handover, slicing, metrics, and visualization capabilities.
